use read_fonts::types::Tag;

pub(crate) struct LangTag {
    pub language: [u8; 4],
    pub tag: Tag,
}

const fn lang(language: &[u8]) -> [u8; 4] {
    let mut bytes = [0; 4];
    let mut i = 0;

    while i < language.len() {
        bytes[i] = language[i];
        i += 1;
    }

    bytes
}
